extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, regulated entities, and stakeholders who may submit comments on the EPA proposed Michigan SIP (RACT) actions
extracted.subtask_short: submitting public comments on EPA SIP rule
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and content requirements for submitting public comments on the EPA proposed rule to approve Michigan SIP revisions for 2015 ozone Moderate RACT (VOC and NOx), including docket identification, submission methods, deadlines, and where to find supporting documents. Also describes document metadata and legal-status guidance for the Federal Register posting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment period deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received on or before May 26, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The comment period for the proposed rule published in the Federal Register on February 27, 2026, at 91 FR 9793 is being reopened. Comments on the proposed rule were required to be received on or before March 30, 2026; in response to a request in a public comment, the EPA is reopening the comment period for the proposed action for 30 days.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to submit comments (methods/addresses)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your comments, identified by Docket ID No. EPA-R05-OAR-2024-0137 (for VOC RACT) or EPA-R05-OAR-2025-0235 (for NOX RACT) at https://www.regulations.gov, or via email to arra.sarah@epa.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Additional instructions to comment can be found in the notice of proposed rulemaking published February 27, 2026 (91 FR 9793). Use the appropriate docket ID depending on which action (VOC RACT or NOX RACT) your comment addresses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Docket identification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be identified by the correct Docket ID: EPA-R05-OAR-2024-0137 (West Michigan VOC RACT) or EPA-R05-OAR-2025-0235 (Western Michigan 2015 Ozone Moderate NOx RACT and revision to Part 8 rules).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When submitting, ensure the comment is filed under the correct docket so it is associated with the proper proposed action and supporting documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comments disclosure and redaction
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies review all submissions and may choose to redact, or withhold, certain submissions (or portions thereof). Submitted comments may not be available to be read until the agency has approved them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume immediate public posting; agencies may withhold or redact information for privacy or other reasons. If privacy/confidentiality is a concern, consider the agency's redaction practices before submitting identifiable information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting documents and docket materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting documents for the dockets include Michigan Technical Support Document, supplemental submittals (e.g., West Michigan VOC RACT, 05/02/2024 supplemental submittal; West Michigan NOx RACT SIP, 05/05/2025 submittal), and letters (e.g., Letter to John Mooney SIP Supplement for Part 8 NOx RACT August 2025).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review supporting documents in the docket to inform comments; FederalRegister.gov displays related documents retrieved with the document's agency dockets. Check those materials for technical detail and context before commenting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document content and headings expected in FR notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Document headings vary by document type but may contain: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action listed in the Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the Document Drafting Handbook for more details. When preparing or reviewing Federal Register notices, expect those standard headings to appear and use them to locate relevant regulatory and docket information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official legal status and verification of FederalRegister.gov content
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype of a 'Web 2.0' version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register, and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on GPO's govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For legal research or definitive citation, verify contents against the official PDF on govinfo.gov. The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice to the public or judicial notice to the courts until ACFR grants it official status; only official editions provide legal notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reopening comment period in response to public request
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to a request in a public comment, the EPA is reopening the comment period for the proposed action for 30 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies may extend or reopen comment periods when warranted by public requests or other considerations; stakeholders can request extensions if more time is needed to prepare comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Regulations.gov data on FederalRegister.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: FederalRegister.gov retrieves relevant information about this document from Regulations.gov to provide users with additional context. This information is not part of the official Federal Register document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat Regulations.gov-derived metadata on FederalRegister.gov as supplemental context and confirm details in the official Federal Register notice or the Regulations.gov docket as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document citation and metadata to reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Published Document: 2026-07905 (91 FR 21753); Document Number 2026-07905; Document Type Proposed Rule; Page 21753; Publication Date 04/23/2026; FR Doc. 2026-07905 filed 4-22-26; 8:45 am.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include accurate document citation (FR volume/page, document number, FR Doc number, publication date) when referencing the notice in comments or other communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: For further information contact Katie Caskey, Air and Radiation Division (AR-18J), Environmental Protection Agency, Region 5, 77 West Jackson Boulevard, Chicago, Illinois 60604, telephone number: (312) 353-3490, email address: caskey.kathleen@epa.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed contact for technical or procedural questions about the proposed action or the submission process.
